plan: To prioritize capital preservation, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU, METU, MSFU) to zero.
This significantly reduces overall portfolio risk and leverage.
QQQI will be trimmed to 20% to meet the single name concentration limit.
The focus is on income and broad index exposure with top-quality names.
A large cash buffer will be maintained for stability.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a target of ~1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged positions and maintaining a cash buffer. Expect lower volatility but also more modest growth potential.

plan: QQQI will be trimmed to 25% to comply with concentration limits.
Leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU, METU, MSFU) will be trimmed to small positions to reduce overall leverage.
This plan blends broad index and quality tech exposure with a small amount of leverage.
A new position in APP will be initiated at 4% based on its strong scanner setup.
A cash buffer of ~10% will be maintained.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while still seeking growth opportunities. Expect moderate volatility and a balanced risk-reward profile.

plan: QQQI will be trimmed to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU, METU, MSFU) will be increased to 6% each, leaning into higher-risk, higher-reward opportunities.
A new position in APP will be initiated at 6% based on its strong scanner setup.
This plan concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups and utilizes leverage for aggressive growth.
A smaller cash buffer will be maintained, and strict stops are crucial.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this approach carries substantially higher drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs are subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is paramount to manage potential rapid losses.

plan: To prioritize steady monthly distributions, all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) and high-beta single names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) will be sold to zero.
QQQI will be increased to 30% to enhance income generation.
The focus is on income and broad index ETFs for reliable distributions.
A cash buffer will be maintained to prioritize low drawdown.
This strategy aims for cash-like income, but distributions are variable and NAV can still fall.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, aiming to park cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index funds. While designed for steady distributions, these are variable, and the NAV can still decline in market downturns; this is not a savings account.
